## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes locally
- [ ] Shared code is in `packages/*`, not in a slide folder or `apps/deck/assets/`
- [ ] No new dependencies, or they were agreed in an issue first
- [ ] Third-party code (`apps/deck/.agents/`, React Bits files) is untouched, or patches are marked `[open-slide]`
- [ ] Docs (README, `AGENTS.md`, package READMEs) are updated if behaviour or commands changed
